title: InferenceReceipt
description: Minimum viable signed, hash-chained record of an agent interaction with an Agent Face (ICE V.01).

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt (UUID v4 recommended).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the observation/action.

id.description: Stable identifier of the agent principal (DID, public key fingerprint, or service URI).

url.description: Primary URL or endpoint that was accessed.

surface.description: Optional classification of the Agent Face surface (e.g., 'llms.txt', 'agent.json', 'mcp', 'openapi').

action.description: High-level description of what the agent did (e.g., 'GET', 'tool_call:search', 'reason').

result_summary.description: Concise, human- and machine-readable summary of the outcome or extracted content.

result_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of the full raw result payload (if retained separately).

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 of the immediately preceding receipt in the chain (or genesis marker for the first).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized receipt body excluding the signature field.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the content_hash (or the full canonical body). Format is implementation-defined in V.01; later versions will standardize.

extensions.description: Optional namespace for future or domain-specific fields.
